summary: scripts/st-test --check rust-tests runs the Rust tests of only the workspace crates that have no passing note for their input key and signs each crate separately (scripts/rust-test-keys, .st/rust-test-inputs.json); evidence-wrap indexes a record that signs source_inputs under it, and evidence-verify takes --crate-key

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. No skip-policy entry and no gate job read the new notes yet; linux-gate is unchanged.
